text:
Aisha: Quick ping  I'm putting together a "Manager pocket kit" — 1 page + calendar snippets + a 30/60/90 starter that fits in an offer email. want to keep it super skimmable.
Carlos: Love the name. Could we add a short pre-start buddy checklist? e.g., intro call 24h before start, confirm laptop delivery ETA, and parking/badge logistics.
Mei: Also include a tiny customer-access note for managers who need production-level dashboards or customer PII access  steps to request and expected SLA.
Jordan: Security note: make MFA and disk encryption the first two bullets. then KMS + runbook access. Mark as MUST/ASAP/OPTIONAL.
Aisha: Draft outline below. trying to keep scheduled meetings under 3.5 hours for week 1.
Aisha: Pre-start (24-72h): buddy intro call (15m), open Okta+infra tickets, confirm laptop + VPN instructions, badge/parking request if on-site. include sample text to copy.
Carlos: Sample pre-start buddy message (copy/paste): "Hi BUDDY  quick intro: I'll be starting on DATE. Can we do a 15m call X day to go over laptop + first-day plan? Thanks!"
Mei: Customer access snippet (copy/paste): "Hi Security/IT  request read-only dashboard access for NAME, ROLE, START_DATE. Purpose: post-onboard customer escalations. Please advise lead time"
OnboardBot: Badge/parking request processed. ETA 2 business days.
Aisha: Day 1 (half-day): 30m People Ops welcome, 20m HR admin, 30m team intro + expectations, 15m quick systems check (Okta, Console links, key runbooks).
Jordan: Day 2: 45m Product context & roadmap, 30m Security intro (how to raise incident + who to page), 30m buddy shadow session.
Aisha: Day 3: 45m 30/60/90 planning workshop (manager-only) with a template they can fork. Day 4: 60m Ops & monitoring primer (alerts, runbooks, SLOs). Day 5: 30m Stakeholder intro + week recap.
Carlos: Calendar bundle to paste into offers:
- Day 0 (pre) 16:00 - Buddy intro call (15m)
- Day 1 09:30 - People Ops: Welcome & Admin (50m)
- Day 1 11:00 - Team intro / expectations (30m)
- Day 2 10:00 - Product + Roadmap (45m)
- Day 3 10:00 - 30/60/90 planning (45m)
- Day 4 09:30 - Ops & Monitoring primer (60m)
- Day 5 14:00 - Stakeholder intro + Week recap (30m)
Mei: 30/60/90 starter (pasteable):
- 30d: meet key partners, confirm all team access, ship one small process improvement.
- 60d: take ownership of a prioritized backlog item, run weekly planning, get first feedback loop.
- 90d: deliver measurable ops or product improvement, set draft OKRs, present progress to stakeholders.
Jordan: 1:1 agenda snippet to paste: "Wins / Blockers / Priorities / Support needed" (15m).
Aisha: Security prioritized checklist (copy/paste):
- MUST: enable MFA, confirm corporate device encryption, provision Okta groups.
- ASAP: KMS access request, read access to incident runbooks.
- OPTIONAL: elevated audit logs, special monitoring alerts.
Carlos: Compliance flag: "If role touches regulated data, schedule Legal+Security intake in week 1."
Mei: Suggest a one-question quick survey at EOW: "Was there any unresolved access issue?" If yes, auto-tag IT. keeps the feedback loop tiny.
Aisha: I'll create a one-page PDF + Google Calendar template and drop link here. Can people review by Tue?
Jordan: I can review Monday morning.
Carlos: I'll proof the copy-paste text tonight.
OnboardBot: Manager pocket kit draft uploaded. Link: https://redwood.link/manager-pocket-kit-draft
Aisha: Thanks team  goal is to reduce offer friction and get managers productive faster. will post final when done. :sparkles:
